SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sorting &, part of CLASSIFICATION in PP2 MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Which objects are grouping the learner should be able to: objects with different colour, size, similar or look alike?
